page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Catchword at the foot right, signature at the foot left.

main_text.p: fumeret : ne dum quacunque oculos ob-vertimus tam uberem & luxuriantem undique Juramentorum & perjuriorum segetem, albescentemque jamdiu ad messem conspicimus; Deus justissimus judex, ad tam perfidam & profanam gentem penitus excindendam, peracu-tam judiciorum falcem celerrime im-mittat. Iratum sensimus jamdiu clementissimum Patrem, & læsam infinities vi-stamque[?] (si fas dicere) peccatis nostris infinitam Dei patientiam in furorem versam. Non facile est dicere, ob quæ potissimum peccata, ubi omnia sunt summa. Sed profecto qui serio cogita-verit, ex quo nos Deus propriore flagel-lo percutere cœpit, de his gravissimis ju-randi pejerandique peccatis quàm non doluimus, imò potius quàm immensum increverit, hinc infrænata & impunita ju-randi & blasphemandi licentia, illinc pejerandi sub Religionis obtentu fœda hypocrisis: vix fieri potest quin ut ei in mentem subinde veniat illud Jeremiæ Prophetæ, A juramentis terra luget.
Quæ cum ita sint, viri, patres & fratres, exorandi sumus qui adsumus omnes, & quotquot uspiam sunt hominum, qui paci cùm publicæ Regni & Ecclesiæ, tùm

page.notes: The word after "vi-" (printed with a ft/st ligature) is uncertain; read as "stamque" and marked [?]. The catchword "tùm" stands at the foot right, after the last line, and is kept there only. Spelling was normalised for long s (s shown as s) and u/v. Printed spelling is otherwise kept (e.g. "pejerandi", "quàm", "imò", "cogita-verit"). Some spellings with long s were read as plain s (e.g. "sensimus", "nostris", "potest"); the printed forms show the same letters in long-s type.
